result.paraphrase: Seagate Game Drive Hub for Xbox STGG8000400 is an 8 TB white external portable hard drive with USB 3.0 and an integrated USB hub. It provides high-capacity storage for 200+ Xbox One games, with dual front-facing USB 3.0 ports for charging controllers and mobile devices or connecting other Xbox One accessories. Officially Xbox-licensed and developed and tested with Xbox for seamless use with any generation of Xbox One, it delivers full gaming performance through high-speed USB 3.0. Setup is fast and tool-free: your Xbox One detects the drive automatically and guides you through installation. You can also plug it into a friend’s Xbox One and continue your game progress. Compatible with Microsoft Xbox gaming consoles, including Xbox One and Xbox One S.
